message:
Now I understand the setup. The `xslt` fuzzer takes an XSLT stylesheet as input. The vulnerability is in `crypto:rc4_decrypt` which can produce invalid UTF-8 in the output. When this invalid UTF-8 string is used in the XSLT transformation output, it can cause a crash in libxml2's UTF-8 handling.

Let me look at the crypto seed for the xpath fuzzer to understand how to call rc4_decrypt:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt/tests/fuzz/seed/xpath/crypto_rc4_decrypt 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt/tests/fuzz/seed/xpath/ | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
